dct_title_s: Atlantic coast. : Cape Sable to Cape Hatteras
dct_description_sm: Depths shown by soundings, dotted lines; relief shown (at Agamenticus Mt. only) by height in feet, hachures.
Lights table, Currents text, submarine bell signals, magnetic variation compass roses, various notes about map and local navigation.
Shows low water areas, islands, coasts, waterways, cities, lights.
1916 "sailing chart" showing coast of northeast states, from North Carolina to southern Nova Scotia.
Stamps: "Rand McNally & Co. Outing - Maps - Tourist 40 East 22nd St., N.Y.C.," and "June 22 1916."
